name: ui.sh
summary: Collection of task-oriented agent skills for building UI: design, ideas, brand kit, componentize, dark mode and responsive workflows.
description: A set of skills that install into AI coding agents and steer UI work: /design builds new UI with senior-designer heuristics; /ideas generates several design directions and inserts an in-browser picker to compare them; /brand-kit turns a product idea into a visual identity board. Other skills refactor code into components, canonicalize Tailwind classes, add dark mode, adapt images to dark mode, make designs responsive and turn screenshots into semantic markup. Install per project with npx @uidotsh/install and an account token.
contains: 9 skills incl. design, ideas, brand-kit, componentize and Tailwind canonicalization
further skills: add dark mode, dark mode image, make responsive, markup from image
skills run as slash commands (/design, /ideas, /brand-kit) inside coding agents
ideas inserts an in-browser option picker to compare generated design directions
design uses senior-designer heuristics for layout, hierarchy, color, spacing and typography
brand-kit outputs a board with two site mockups plus typography and color guidance
tested with Claude Code (Opus) and Codex; brand-kit requires Codex image generation
